For those who don't like being rush leveled, I am going to start posting leveling guides for each class. You should always play in a group when leveling; however, when soloing you should always use the templar. His final skill grants you extra resource regen which trumps the benefits of the scoundrel and enchantress IMO. For all the class guides just keep in mind to pick only the left skills on the templar. They unlock at level 5, 10, 15, 20. Before we get started, there are a few more tips not specific to an individual class. Always steal your followers weapon at level 1. Play on adventure mode and on Hard difficulty. Never play on Expert, it is statistically inefficient to farm regardless of how fast you can shred it. If you can rip Expert mode to shreds then you should step up to Master. If you are leveling in Hardcore, consider dropping to Normal if you are taking half your life in damage while facing an elite on Hard.

There are only 5 efficient bounties to farm when leveling:

  1. The Cursed Chapel - Act IV - Silver Spire Level 2
  2. Cursed Bellows - Act I - Halls of Agony Level 3
  3. Cursed Cellar - Act I - Old Ruins
  4. Cursed Court - Act I - Cathedral Level 2
  5. Cursed Outpost - Act II - Howling Plateau

You should always clear Halls of Agony Level 3 (and Level 2 if you want). The Halls of Agony Level 3 has a high chance to spawn a cursed chest and the monster density is amazing. Now that you no longer have to farm regular rift keystones, you can start doing rifts once you get to level 15. Stick to the bounties early on and farm Halls of Agony Level 3.

You can find rings at level 6 from the vendors. As you will be tight on gold if this is your first seasonal character do not buy rings unless they have +dmg. Same thing at level 10 with Amulets. Check each act, and if you don't find any don't waste time restarting the game just keep playing and check again later.

Finally, make sure that you value +XP on your gear almost as much as you would DPS. For example, if you have a piece of gear with no +XP and you find an new item that lowers your DPS by 0-4% but gives you +XP per kill, throw that baby on. If a piece of gear lowers your DPS in any other case, throw it out. Of course, as soon as you can, get a socketed helm and put in a Ruby gem. This is the single most important thing for leveling early on. At level 20 you can kill Leoric on Story Mode for a garunteed Leoric's crown (with a garunteed socket). This is a great way to speed up leveling from 20-40 on any class.

Wizard Leveling Guide

Levels 1-11

Hop into Adventure Mode on Hard Difficulty. Steal your templar's weapon. Hire your templar if your soloing, and take the Enchantress' weapon for your Templar. Check for the above list of Bounties and complete them all. It is not uncommon to get none of the listed bounties when you start a game. If this is the case, clear Halls of Agony 3 (never kill the Butcher) and the restart the game. When you hit level 3 change your left click to Shock Pulse. When you hit level 5 change your right click to Arcane Orb. At Level 6 you can change your left click to Magic Missile- Charged Blast and then check for +dmg rings at the vendors. Remember to pick up everything you see if this is your first character of the season (or on your account) and break them down for crafting mats. Once you get to level 8 craft an Apprentice War Axe.

At level 9 change your right click to Wave of Force. This will be your right click for the rest of the leveling process. This would have automatically been set to the number 2 slot, so equip Diamond Skin on the second skill slot (make sure you have elective mode checked off in game options). Once again, at level 10 check the vendors for +dmg Amulets. You also get your first passive slot now, so put on blur. At level 11 change your left click to Spectral Blade which will now be your left click for the rest of the leveling process. At level 11, this should be your skill set.

Levels 12-24

At level 12 equip the Shatter Rune to Frost Nova. At level 13 you should change your passive to Evocation. If you are playing on hardcore, you should gauge the usefulness of Blur vs. Evocation and choose which ever suits your playstyle. At level 14 equip the Crytal Shell Rune to Diamond Skin and set your third skill slot to Ice Armor. At level 15 you should immediately craft an Apprentice Flamberge.

You are ready to start throwing in some rifts into the leveling process. Still check for the good bounties but clear at least one rift everytime you start a game.

If you are on softcore, switch your first passive to Glass Cannon at level 16. Using Glass Cannon on Hardcore is not the safest idea but if you have enough toughness it should not be a problem. Again, when playing on Hardcore test the skill change on Normal difficulty to see if it suits your playstyle.

At level 18, change the Frost Nova rune to Cold Snap, and craft a Journeyman Gnarled Staff. This Frost Nova rune will stay on for the remainder of the levelign process.

At level 19 you finally get the fourth skill slot. You can equip anything at level 19.

At level 20 you have a few things to do. First, set the fourth skill slot to Magic Weapon and change the Diamond Skin rune to Prism. You have just unlocked your second passive slot and you have a few options. (Option 1) Your best combination available right now on softcore is Glass Cannon and Prodigy. (Safest Option - Hardcore) For max survivability use Evocation and Blur. (Hardcore Option 2) Another great combo in Hardcore is Blur and Prodigy.

Once you set your skills, pack your bags and head for the campaign. Clear Act I until you kill the Skeleton King and grab your Leoric's Crown. Pop a ruby gem into that bad boy and head back to adventure mode.

At level 21, you get the first Ice Armor rune, Chilling Aura. At level 22 you should equip the Wave of Force Rune, Debilitating Force. Craft yourself an Adept Bone Staff.. Keep leveling until you get to 24. Equip the Siphoning Blades Rune to Spectral Blade. This will be your LMB for the rest of the leveling process. You just unlocked Astral Presence. IMO everyone should have this passive on at level 24. If you went with Option 1 before then you should swap out Prodigy for Astral Presence. If you are on Hardcore, your best bet right now is Astral Presence and either Blur or Evocation.

At level 24, this should be your skill set.

Levels 25-35

Level 26: Craft a Master Battle Staff.

Level 27: Put the Electrify Rune on Magic Weapon.

Level 29: Craft a Master Great Axe.

Level 30: Equip the Prodigy passive as your third passive.

Level 31: Change Diamond Skin to Teleport.

Level 32: Change the Wave of Force rune to Arcane Attunement.

Level 33: Change your Ice Armor to Storm Armor - Power of the Storm.

Level 35: Equip the Force Weapon Rune to Magic Weapon and craft a Grand Master War Staff.

At level 35 this should be your skill set.

Levels 36-70

You only have a few skill changes remaining on your journey to 70. The main factor in your leveling speed now is the damage of your weapon. So the rest of the guide is predominantly what to craft and when. Around Level 40 you will want to start trying for a rather important weapon. You should upgrade your Blacksmith to level 10 and craft an Exalted Sagaris (Level 58 Two-Handed Axe). Your aim is to get one with Level Requirement Reduced by 10. The best way to do this is to craft with the aim of getting the secondary skill % chance to Fear/Stun/Immobilize/etc.. This gives you a high chance of rerolling the OTHER secondary slot for Reduced Level Requirement. Do not enchant it too many times! This will sap your finances if you are just starting out. Instead, it is better to enchant a few times, and if you don't get a good reduced level requirement roll, simply craft another axe and try again.

Level 40: Illustrious Obsidian Staff

Level 42: Magnificent Elder Staff

Level 47: Resplendent High Priest Staff

Level 48-61: You should be using the Exalted Sagaris you crafted as soon as you can (Level 48 - 58). At level 49 you get the Heat Wave Rune for Wave of Force. At level 50 you should change your Storm Armor to Familiar - Arcanot. If you are on hardcore, you can work in an armor, by not using either Magic Weapon of Arcanot. You can however play without an Armor skill, just make sure you have enough toughness.

At level 61 you should craft an Exquisite Caduceus Staff. As soon as you have the deaths breath, upgrade your blacksmith to level 12. Follow the same process as you did for the Exalted Sagaris but now with the level 70 wep Sovereign Persuader.

At level 66 you can start using the passive Audacity which has recently been given a solid buff. Check it out and see if it fits your play style.

Throughout leveling, stick to Hard mode primarily. It is most often the most efficient difficulty to level on.
